posts.subject: Suspected cheater - Konojaro
posts.bodyHtml:
Hey there!


I was playing on the Knife server and there happened to be a player which was completely overruling everyone from the best of the best players to the more lower rated players. Doo Doo, Kappa (Knawledge), Gasomii, Teeqo and many others were there to also witness it. All of us were thinking the same thing and Doo Doo did have a chat with him but at the point I'm writing this I do not believe it has been dealt with. I have a screenshot from one map of how well he played as well as his overall profile... He was doing many suspicious things such as jumping and killing from above you constantly, rushing with no fear killing most if not all players in his path and even 360 killing sometimes.


Player name: Konojaro


Steam link:


Here are a few attached screenshots:


Thanks ~Swifty 😄

Hey,


I'm very sorry to disappoint you, but the evidence you provided is not enough proof for us to punish the suspected player in any way.
I agree to you that his profile/score indeed looks very suspicious but it could just be a smurf account of an experienced player as well.


To judge on this case we need clear evidence that he's cheating, which maybe could be delivered by recording a demo what you should try to do next time you see him on the server. Till then admins have to keep an eye on him and may ban him, should they catch him in the act.


Sincerely


BlackFire
Thanks Blackfire, however I just looked at the Banlist and he did get banned 😄 So this thread no longer is any use.
Maybe he is just a Smurf ? 😏

Zitat von KAMIKATZE
